main_text.p: mystico confundenda, vel obtorto collo istûc trahenda est. Accommodationes, assimilationes, translationes, ubi ipsa Scriptura facit, agnoscendæ sunt procul dubio: sed ut nos eas vel queramus, vel fabricemus ubique & semper, non præ-unte Spiritû Sancto, à solidâ Theologiâ alienum est.

4. Ex eo, quòd peccatum sit opus ser-vile spiritualiter, quódque alia opera ser-vilia ex peccato processerint, non rectè colligitur Sabbathum primò & principa-liter institutum esse ad figurandam absti-nentiam à peccato: tùm quòd ejus insti-tutio antiquior sit peccato, & ad aliam o-riginem atque causam referatur in SS.Li-teris; tùm quòd Deus non solùm prohi-buerit opera servilia, servorum & ancilla-rum, quæ molestiora esse solent, sed & reliqua ad hanc vitam pertinentia, licet minùs molesta, etiàm herorum, & filio-rum, & filiarum, &c. quia est Sabbathum Jehovæ, ipsi sanctificandum, ejus cultû transsigendum; Exod. xx, 8 -- 11. Deut. v, 12, 13, 14.

page.notes: Printed page number "230" appears at top left as "2 3o". Catchword "fio" is the continuation of "Confessio" at the foot right. Some words at the line ends are partly obscured by ink spots; "præ-unte" reads "prece-unte" in part, rendered as printed. Marginal blots and a watermark were excluded.
